evidence: UNVERIFIED: Pantai Mangatasik (Tombariri) described as white sand partly gravel and busy with local visitors, but no source on swimming; Pantai Kalasey gisik is fine sand to pebble with abrasion - https://ejournal.unsrat.ac.id/v3/index.php/JAP/article/view/40077

Pantai Dato (2.5 km from Majene town) has a sandy section and a coral section; tourism potential listed includes swimming, snorkeling and diving - https://cot.unhas.ac.id/journals/index.php/jwkm/article/download/1324/931

Pantai Pasir Putih (Kec. Rajabasa, Lampung Selatan) has soft white sand and clear calm water described as ideal for swimming; sources disagree on exact location (Rajabasa vs Tarahan) - https://www.goodnewsfromindonesia.id/2024/11/01/rekomendasi-pantai-terbaik-di-kalianda-lampung-selatan-untuk-liburan-akhir-tahun

Pantai Suwuk has big waves and swimming is discouraged (drowning 2014); Pantai Pecaron (Kebumen) has calm waves described as suitable for swimming or playing in water; sand type not explicitly stated in source - https://mamikos.com/info/?p=107054
Lovina has grey/black volcanic sand beaches with calm water, generally safe for swimming; caveat some central stretches dirty with plastic - https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lovina

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Batu Putih (Tangkoko, Bitung) has black sand but visitors are advised not to swim due to large waves; no swimming evidence found for other Bitung beaches (Lembeh only a private resort beach) - https://kumparan.com/kumparantravel/5-pantai-unik-di-indonesia-ada-yang-tawarkan-sensasi-berjalan-di-tengah-laut-1wNeWYSccPy

Pulau Moyo (Sumbawa Regency) known for white sand beaches incl. Tanjung Pasir; visitors can swim and snorkel on the island's beaches - https://www.merahputih.com/post/read/pulau-moyo-surga-dunia-yang-terselip-di-nusa-tenggara-barat

Pantai Baqbatoa (Lapeo, Campalagian) has relatively calm safe water; visitors soak, swim and play beach football; sand colour not stated (white sand confirmed at nearby Palippis in same regency via detik.com) - https://rri.co.id/mamuju/hiburan/2598263/pantai-baqbatoa-lapeo-pilihan-wisata-bahari-di-polewali-mandar

Pantai Liang (Maluku Tengah) described as safe for swimming with floats available; white sand per GNFI - https://www.indonesia.travel/gb/en/travel-ideas/adventure/satu-hari-di-ambon-lakukan-3-aktivitas-wisata-ini/

Pantai Kerang Mas (Labuhan Maringgai, Lampung Timur) has thick clean whitish-brown sand; swimming called the most enjoyable activity; caveat oil waste reported 2022 - https://www.inews.id/travel/destinasi/pantai-kerang-mas/all

UNVERIFIED: Antara lists Pantai Kahona in Panai Hilir, Labuhanbatu but gives no sand or swimming details; other sources place Pantai Kahona in Pandan, Tapanuli Tengah - https://sumut.antaranews.com/berita/174239/labuhanbatu-miliki-15-objek-wisata-alam

BPBD Kotim asked visitors swimming at Pantai Ujung Pandaran to beware jellyfish (Dec 2024), showing people swim there; gentle shallow slope; sand type not explicitly stated in found sources - https://www.metrotvnews.com/read/NP6CpxBa-wisatawan-pantai-ujung-pandaran-diminta-waspada-sengatan-ubur-ubur
Samber Beach (Yendidori, Biak Barat) has soft white sand and clear water suitable for swimming and playing in the water - https://www.indonesia.travel/id-id/travel-ideas/adventure/samber-beach/

Pantai Rupat Utara (Bengkalis) has pristine white sand and gentle waves; swimming is a popular pastime; Beting Aceh island nearby also white sand - https://sandee.com/indonesia/riau/teluk-rhu/pantai-rupat-utara

UNVERIFIED: BPBD Aceh Barat banned swimming along Meulaboh coast incl. Suak Ribee (Apr 2026) after drownings; Lhok Bubon (Samatiga) rated suitable for marine tourism with coral sand but no swimming source found - https://www.metrotvnews.com/read/bD2Cwl07-warga-aceh-barat-dilarang-berenang-di-pantai-meulaboh-ini-penyebabnya

Pantai Alam Indah (Mintaragen, Tegal Timur) has whitish-brown sand and fairly gentle waves, safe for swimming within staff-set limits; caveat seasonal swimming bans in west monsoon (2012) - https://mamikos.com/info/tempat-wisata-di-tegal-gnr/?halaman=4
Pantai Amal Lama (Tarakan) has a wide white sand expanse; visitors relax, play in sand or swim in the sea - https://www.indonesia.travel/au-en/destination/kalimantan/north-kalimantan/pantai-amal-lama

Pantai Gandoriah (Pariaman Tengah) has gently sloping clean sand; often used for playing in waves or swimming near the shore - https://www.popmama.com/life/health/spot-wisata-pantai-menyenangkan-saat-berkunjung-ke-sumatera-barat-00-5xgld-tlt71d

UNVERIFIED: Lumpue northern part dominated by sand with low wave energy (dissipative), but no source describes swimming; visitors call it dirty/neglected - https://ojs.unm.ac.id/paratiwi/article/download/52801/26772
Koka Beach (Paga, Sikka) long wide white sand beach; one bay calm for swimming, visitors picnic and swim - https://cycloscope.net/maumere-koka-beach-travel-guide/
